newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Svyazinvest tender terms seen next week.
newsitem.headline: Russian Svyazinvest tender terms seen next week.

text.p: Russia has postponed announcing tender conditions for a 25 percent plus one share stake in telecom holding company Svyazinvest, probably by about a week, a spokesman for the privatisation minister said on Tuesday.

"It could have happened if not for the holiday," Viktoria Vergelskaya, press secretary to privatisation minister and State Property Fund Chairman Alfred Kokh told Reuters. Markets will be closed for Russian Independence Day on Thursday.
"However, it is quite possible that it will be announced next week," she said.

The tender of AO Svyazinvest, which has controlling stakes in most regional telecoms and will be the largest privatisation in Russia when a total of 49 percent is sold, was due to be announced on Tuesday, Kokh said last week.
The government will also sell a 24 percent stake to Russian investors, probably next year according to Kokh.
The starting price for the 25 percent plus one share stake, which is large enough to block changes to the charter, has been set preliminarily at $1.18 billion dollars.
